scope: Read-only descriptive join of exact generator replay and all four existing prediction audits; all twelve classes retained; train/validation separate; no test, inference or training.
gate: Require successful replay and audit completion markers, matching metadata/parameter hashes, verified replay JSONL and CSV hashes, unique complete source-ID joins, correct labels/IQ digests and reproduction of each full CSV confusion matrix.
bin_rule: left inclusive, right exclusive except final upper edge inclusive; h=0.5 belongs to 0.5:0.6; missing BT explicitly not_applicable; out-of-range fails
primary: For each model and split: FSK class x h-bin, class x BT-bin, class x Gaussian span; repeat at SNR>=15dB.
secondary: Class x h-bin x BT-bin; descriptive only. Show counts, unique conditions, prediction-label counts, accuracy and sparse flag n<20. Do not pool four models into independent samples.
interpretation: Association only; h/BT bins may differ in bandwidth/SNR/offset. No causal attribution, class removal, automatic intervention, threshold search or statistical significance claim.
outputs: Fresh timestamp directory with report and success marker only after all four models and both splits pass. Preserve failure report. Existing artifacts unchanged.
